verdict.rationale: Grounding public claims in government data is a fair question for an immigration law firm, so the axis applies. The pack only shows the firm naming agencies (USCIS, Department of Labor, Department of State) and attaching its own summaries of visa provisions. It contains no USCIS processing data, FOIA statistics, or linked official policy citations backing its claims.

support.subject: As a developer evaluating providers, the provider grounds its public claims in government data — USCIS processing data, FOIA statistics, or official policy citations with links
